chapter.heading: BOOK 1
chapter.v:
Blessed is
the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked,nor stand on the path of sinners,nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

but his
delight is in Yahweh’s law.On his law he meditates day and night.

He will
be like a tree planted by the streams of water,that produces its fruit in its season,whose leaf also does not wither.Whatever he does shall prosper.

The wicked
are not so,but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

Therefore the
wicked shall not stand in the judgment,nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

For Yahweh
knows the way of the righteous,but the way of the wicked shall perish.
